title: Generic defaults pack (technology costs, finance defaults, illustrative tariffs, synthetic load profiles)

campus_equipment.rows: one `investment` part per entry: overnight (capex_eur, capex_eur_per_km for a cable, per bay for switchgear), lifetime (lifetime_a), fom_share (opex_frac)

template_technologies.rows: one `investment` part per MW: overnight, fom_share, lifetime and (except onwind) efficiency, in 2020 EUR; gas-genset ← OCGT, diesel-genset ← oil, onwind ← onwind, fuel-cell ← fuel cell, electrolysis ← electrolysis
template_technologies.why: IC S3 seeds (owner 2026-10-13, Q1 a): the Energy Hub templates and redundancy placeholders derive their costs from the pack

ammonia_technologies.rows: one `investment` part each: overnight, fom_share, lifetime, in 2020 EUR; haber-bosch ← Haber-Bosch (per MW of NH3), nh3-tank ← NH3 (l) storage tank incl. liquefaction, h2-tank ← hydrogen storage tank type 1 including compressor
ammonia_technologies.why: grid-to-process ticket 05: the ammonia tracer template eh_ammonia_staged prices its tanks from the pack; the Haber-Bosch loop is a sunk, fixed-size unit whose rows serve the investment case. The Haber-Bosch electricity input (0.2473 MWh_el/MWh_NH3) is a template number, ledgered there

load_profiles.label: Commercial office (synthetic shape)
load_profiles.source: synthetic: guided investment study S4, a stated shape (weekday 08-18 plateau, night and weekend base, summer cooling uplift), not a measurement
load_profiles.note: Scaled to the intake's annual MWh; replace with a metered load to leave screening maturity.

load_profiles.label: Industrial, two shifts (synthetic shape)
load_profiles.source: synthetic: guided investment study S4, a stated shape (weekday 06-22 two shifts, night and weekend base, August and December shutdown dips), not a measurement
load_profiles.note: Scaled to the intake's annual MWh; replace with a metered load to leave screening maturity.

typed_cost_units.why: GS-2b: capacity_basis, includes_grid_connection and money_year on every row; same numbers as 2026-10-20
